name: Ambiguous Gaussians Removal
definition: A strategy for SA3D-GS to remove ambiguous Gaussians at object borders with similar colors (e.g., reflective metal), which cause artifacts in segmentation.
summary: Ambiguous Gaussians Removal is a lightweight post-processing strategy that eliminates 3D Gaussians at object borders with similar colors, bypassing complex segmentation decoders to achieve negligible time cost.
